$comment: Icon mappings. THE source of truth for which glyph means what, on every platform.
THREE SOURCES, not two. Most icons take the platform's native set -- an SF Symbol
on iOS, a Material Symbol on Android -- because matching the platform is usually
worth more than matching ourselves. But a few icons are load-bearing enough to the
UI that no native symbol is good enough, and those get a custom SVG drawn to sit
with the platform's own: matched optical size, matched stroke weight.
`custom` names an SVG in brand/assets/icons/. When present it wins on every
platform, and the ios/android entries stay as the fallback and as a record of what
was rejected. Keep the custom set small -- every one is a drawing to maintain, and
the reason to have any is that a couple of icons are worth it, not that consistency
is worth it everywhere.
Edit here, then run `node brand/scripts/generate-icons.mjs` to regenerate
apps/ios/ShabadOS/AppIcons.swift and
apps/android/app/src/main/java/com/shabados/android/AppIcons.kt.
Never edit those two files — they are generated and will be overwritten.
Why this is data and not a table in a markdown document (ADR-0013): one
semantic name maps to N platform values, and a prose table is a promise while a
generator is enforcement. It also carries availability, which prose cannot check.
`minIOS` is VERIFIED against the system symbol database
(/System/Library/CoreServices/CoreGlyphs.bundle name_availability.plist) on
2026-09-02. The generator compares it against IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET and
fails if a symbol needs a newer iOS than the app targets and has no `fallback`.
A missing SF Symbol renders as NOTHING — a blank button in front of a
congregation — so this check is the point of the file.
`android.verified` is false everywhere: no Material Symbols name here has been
checked against a real icon set. Verify in Android Studio (New > Vector Asset >
Clip Art, which is searchable and offline) before trusting any of them.
`web` names the existing Qwik component under apps/web/src/components/icons/,
or null where none exists yet. Web is not generated — recorded so the three
platforms can be seen to disagree.

journeys.meaning: Open the Journeys sidebar. Specified by the author.

journeysActive.meaning: Journeys sidebar is open; tapping returns to the viewer. Same shape, filled.

controls.$why: Neither slider.horizontal.2.square nor Material's tune is good enough for a control this central. A candidate for the custom set -- see $comment.

controlsActive.meaning: Controls sidebar is open. PROPOSED, as above.

zoom.meaning: Font size of the reading area. Specified by the author.

ratio.meaning: Secondary text size relative to the Gurmukhi line. Specified by the author.

weight.meaning: Font weight. Specified by the author.

width.meaning: Reading column width. Wide surfaces only. PROPOSED — not specified.

mode.meaning: Rendering mode: classic / saral / reader / presenter. Specified by the author.

centered.meaning: Centre the text. Specified by the author.

continuous.meaning: Larivaar — remove spaces from the Gurmukhi line. Specified by the author.

pauses.meaning: Colour vishraam words. Specified by the author.

pronunciations.meaning: Transliteration schemes, computed by packages/gurmukhi. Specified by the author.

translations.meaning: Translation languages. Specified by the author.

ios.$why: Was iOS 17.4 against a 17.0 target and needed a fallback. The target is now 26.0, so it resolves directly; the generator will fail again if the target is ever lowered below 17.4.

appearance.meaning: Light / dark / auto. Specified by the author.

filter.meaning: Filter in All recents: All / Pinned / Recent / Inactive. PROPOSED.

disclosure.meaning: Trailing chevron on the All recents row. PROPOSED.

collections.meaning: The Collections row, pinned below Recents. PROPOSED — destination undefined.

about.meaning: About Shabad OS — links, social, feedback. PROPOSED.

search.meaning: Search. PROPOSED — the shell has no specified entry point yet.

remove.meaning: Move an entry to a journey's Removed section. Not a delete. PROPOSED.

undo.meaning: Restore a removed entry to its original position. PROPOSED.

share.meaning: Share a journey — a bookmark position, or a Defined journey. PROPOSED.

next.meaning: Next entry in a journey. PROPOSED.

previous.meaning: Previous entry in a journey. PROPOSED.

streak.meaning: Consecutive days with a complete Defined instance. PROPOSED.

settings.meaning: Advanced settings, one level beyond the Controls sidebar. PROPOSED.

back.meaning: Return from Settings to the Controls sidebar. PROPOSED.

close.meaning: Close a tab. Removes it from the journey permanently; the timeline keeps it. PROPOSED.

tracked.meaning: A tracked collection or bookmark. PROPOSED.
